questions.q:
Sameer gave very less information to Muneer about the progress of the work.

[CGL 23/8/2021 S3]
o: gave very less informations
give very less information
questions.s: "little" is used to indicate a small amount, and it should be used with uncountable nouns like "information." "Less" is typically used with countable nouns, so "very little" is the correct answer.

questions.q:
He is a good singer of the two.

[CHSL 08/07/2019 S3]
questions.s: When comparing two people, the correct comparative form of the adjective "good" is "better.”

questions.q: They bought a sturdy, medium, brown, rectangular, Canadian, wooden desk for the home office.
o: They bought a sturdy, medium
wooden desk for the home office.
questions.s:
If the adjective of size, color, age etc. Come together in a sentence, they should be used in this order: Opinion -> Size -> Age -> Shape -> Color -> Origin -> Material -> Purpose. So, The correct option is: (b), brown, rectangular, Canadian,

The correct sentence would be: "They bought a sturdy, medium, rectangular, brown, Canadian, wooden desk for the home office."

questions.q: This is (a) / a very unique (b) / moment. (c) / No error (d)
questions.s: The error is in part (b). 'Unique' is absolute; 'very unique' is incorrect. Correct form is 'a unique moment.' Answer: (b). 'Unique' absolute hai, 'very unique' galat hai. Sahi form hai 'a unique moment.' Jawab: (b).

questions.q: This task is (a) / very much difficult (b) / to complete. (c) / No error (d)
questions.s: The error is in part (b). 'Much' is redundant; correct form is 'very difficult.' Answer: (b). 'Much' extra hai, sahi form hai 'very difficult.' Jawab: (b).

questions.q: Of the three, women wine and songs,/ the former/ brought about his ruin.
o: Of the three, women wine and songs,
questions.s: Explanation:- Use first in place of former. Kyunki yahan teen me se sabse pehle waale ki baat karni hai isliye 'first' ka use hoga 'former' word ka use hum tab karte hain jab do me se pehle ko kehna hota hai.

questions.q:
Directions: Fine out the error in each of the following sentences, if any. If there is no error, the answer is 'no error'.

Whole the chapter of the book is full of printing / errors which are the outcome / of the proof reader's carelessness. /No Error
o: Whole the chapter of the book is full of printing
errors which are the outcome
of the proof reader's carelessness.
No Error
questions.s: ‘whole the’ के बदले 'the whole' का प्रयोग होगा । ‘whole′ एक Quantitative Adjective है जिसके पहले the का प्रयोग होता है, न कि बाद में। किन्तु, All (जो Numeral Adjective है तथा Quantitative भी) हमेशा अपने बाद the लेता है; जैसे— All the boys, या, All the news.

questions.q: We tried to do much more than (a)/ work as possible by ourselves (b)/ because we did not (c)/ want to rely on others. (d)/ No error (e)
o: We tried to do much more than
questions.s: Use "as much work as possible" instead of "much more than work as possible.”

questions.q: No less than thousands of spectators are/ waiting for Dhoni to come out/ in the field and play his / masterful stroke.
o: No less than thousands of spectators are
waiting for Dhoni to come out
in the field and play his
masterful stroke
questions.s: Explanation:-   Use fewer in place of less. Kyunki 'no less than' is phrase ka use uncountable cheezon ke liye hota hai aur 'no fewer than' is phrase ka use countable cheezon ke liye hota hai. Aage likha thousands of spectators se pata chal rha hai ki veh countable hai plural hai isliye 'no fewer than' ka use hoga.

questions.q:
Pallavi is the cleverest of the two sisters.

[MTS 06/8/2019 S1]
questions.s: When comparing two people, the comparative form "cleverer" should be used instead of the superlative "cleverest."

questions.q: Now-a-days (a)/the weather (b)/is getting more cold (c)/and colder. (d)

Time is the greater/ eraser, both of/ sorrow and of joy.

[SSC MTS Tier-01 20/06/23]
questions.s: "the greater eraser" should be corrected to "the greatest eraser" to indicate the superlative degree.

questions.q: If conventional arrangements and/patterns are made more scarcer, other/arrangements and patterns will spring up. (SSC CHSL Tier-01 13/03/23)
o: Patterns are made more scarcer, other
Arrangements and patterns will spring up
questions.s: 'More scarcer' is a double comparative. 'Scarcer' is already the comparative form of 'scarce'.

questions.q: He likes to put all the garbage into a black small bag.
questions.s: Explanation:- (d) use ‘small black bag’ instead of ‘black small bag’ kyunki kisi noun ke pehle use kiya jaane waale qualitative adjectives ka order opinion-Size-Age-Shape-Colour-Origin-Material hota hai.

questions.q: Much of the art he/ discusses is funny, playing/and mischievous. (SSC MTS Tier-01 03/05/23)
questions.s: Adjectives in a series should be parallel. 'playing' should be 'playful' to match 'funny' and 'mischievous'.

questions.q:
Prashant is better from more other players of our school.

[CGL Mains- 28/01/2022]
questions.s: When comparing one person to others, "than" should be used instead of "from", and "most" is used for a majority of the group.

questions.q: Unity in diversity is the most (noticeable) quality of India.
questions.s: remarkable = an adjective meaning striking, worthy of attention (fits the context best)

questions.q: Largest farmers usually / have more money, social power / and local influence. (SSC MTS Tier-01 17/05/23)
questions.s: The superlative adjective 'Largest' should be preceded by the definite article 'The'.

questions.q: It is well know (a)/that Mrs. Indira Gandhi (b)/was the first statesman (c)/of her time. (d)
He walked more faster (a)/ as he could so that (b)/ he would not (c)/ miss the train to work. (d)/ No error (e)
o: as he could so that
miss the train to work.
questions.s: Double comparative error. Use simply "He walked faster" - remove "more" before "faster.”

questions.q:
For example, the parent mountain / of Mont Blanc, the / high peak in the Alps, is the Mount Everest.

(SSC MTS Tier-01 16/06/23)
o: For example, the parent mountain
Of Mont Blanc, the
High peak in the Alps, is the Mount Everest
questions.s: "the high peak in the Alps" should be corrected to "the highest peak in the Alps" to indicate the superlative degree.

questions.q: (a) The circulation of The Statesman/(b) is greater than/(c) that of any newspaper/(d) No error.
The weather / is much / more warmer / than it was a few days before.
o: than it was a few days before.
questions.s: Explanation:- (a) Warmer se pehle likha gaya 'more' hatana padega kyunki warmer already comparative degree hai iske sath more laga kar ise aur comparative banane ki zarurat nahi hi. Agar 'intensity' hi badhane ki baat hai toh uske liye 'much' already laga hua hai. Isliye yahan 'more' ko drop kar diya jayega.

questions.q:
The park was well lighted at night but it was deserted, so it was a bit scared.

[CHSL 15/10/20S3]
o: so it was a bit scared
questions.s: "Scared" is used for people feeling fear, while "scary" describes something that causes fear. The correct phrase is "a bit scary" to describe the park.
